Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1149
Claimant:
Sarah Stevens
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
01/12/2025
Claim received for a side impact at an intersection, with the insured's vehicle struck on the driver's side by another
vehicle. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all futrher contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
01/22/2025
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver involved is listed as a named driver, and the loss falls within the
coverage period with nothing suggesting the damage predates it.
01/28/2025
Obtained statements from the other driver and two independent witnesses, all of whom describe the collision
happening as the claimant reported it. Scene photos are consistent with the vehicle damage and the direction of
impact.
01/29/2025
The claimant reports a wrist fracture from the crash. Medical records reviewed so far show the injury is a plausible
result of an impact of this type, and no prior injury to the same area appears in the history on file.
05/09/2025
Treatment followed a usual course, with casting, follow-up visits, and therapy, and the treating notes show steday
improvement that has tapered off over recent weeks.
06/11/2025
The claimant has since added a few smaller details about the event, but the core account has not changed from the
first statement taken through counsel.
06/16/2025
It is still unclear from the materials on hand exactly where the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the moment of
impact, and the question is noted for follow-up with counsel.
08/20/2025
While checking prior records on the vehicle, found a report from an earlier accident showing similar major damage to
the same area, which was never submitted to us at the time. The current claim presents that damage as new, so the
discrepancy has been flagged for further review.
08/28/2025
Referred the file for a supervisor review to address the prior-damage record and the open question about seating
position before any settlement position is taken. Counsel will be notified of the review and asked for the outstanding
information.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
